title: Train Puzzle
description: Swap track tiles to build a railway for a moving train before it runs out of rails in this free isometric puzzle you play in your browser.
about:
Train Puzzle is a race against your own locomotive. The train leaves its tunnel as soon as the level starts, rolling across a colorful isometric board of scrambled track pieces toward a goal on the far side. Your job is to lay a working route in front of it, tile by tile, before it reaches a gap.

You always hold one spare track piece. Tap or click any free tile to swap it with your spare, or drag the spare piece straight onto the board, so every move changes the piece you hold next. Coral blocks cannot be moved, and once the train rolls over a tile it is locked in place. Steer it into a dead end and it derails; bring it home and the level is complete.

Every level generates a fresh random layout and the train gets a little faster each time. Your level is saved in your browser, so you can come back later and carry on, and the difficulty slider sets the base speed, from a gentle crawl to a real test of quick thinking.
howToPlay: Press Play and the train starts moving from its tunnel. Tap or click a track tile to swap it with your spare piece, or drag the spare piece onto a tile, and build a connected route to the goal. If the train reaches a tile that does not continue its track, it derails and you can try the level again. When your route is complete, press Finished to send the train at full speed and move on to the next level.

Drop it onto the tile you want to replace

Speed the train to the goal

tips: Work on the tiles right in front of the train first, then extend the route toward the goal.
Before swapping, look at the spare piece you hold: it is the one that will land on the board.
A swap you don't need can still help, because it gives you the piece you actually want next.
Each level is a little faster than the last, so a low difficulty gives you more room to climb.
Press Finished only when the whole route is connected: the train speeds up and cannot be slowed down again.

faq.question: Is Train Puzzle free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Train Puzzle is completely free and runs in your browser, with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap a tile to swap it, or drag the spare piece onto the board. The board resizes to fill the screen in both portrait and landscape, with the spare piece and buttons beside or below it.

faq.question: Is my progress saved?
faq.answer: Yes. Your current level, best level and difficulty are saved in your browser. Press Continue to pick up where you left off, or Start again from level 1.

faq.question: How do I change the difficulty?
faq.answer: Use the difficulty slider on the start ticket before pressing Play: higher values make the train move faster, leaving you less time to build the track.
